video_title: Philadelphia 76ers Postgame Media Availability 🎙️ | VJ Edgecombe | 10.22.26

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the team's poor first-half performance
quotes.excerpt: We just know that was not us in that first half. Too many silly turnovers, careless turnovers.
quotes.quote: We just know that was not us in that first half. Too many silly turnovers, careless turnovers, wasn't rebounding, wasn't playing defense for real. But like I say, we know that we're going to face a lot of adversity this year, and that was one of them, and it's all about how we respond. That was the main thing when we were in the locker room, how we're going to respond to being down 30 points, 29 points.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe on the Sixers falling behind by 29 points in the first half: We just know that was not us. Too many silly turnovers, careless turnovers, wasn't rebounding, wasn't playing defense for real.

structured.context: VJ Edgecombe discusses the team's poor first-half performance and their need to respond to adversity after trailing by 30 points.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe

quotes.excerpt: I think we need a little more time together for me to for us to point exactly.
quotes.quote: To be honest, I need more time. I think we need a little more time together for me to for us to point exactly what the roles are. You know, I say we got a team full of great players, and anyone can go off at any given night. quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on the team's second-half offensive execution
quotes.excerpt: We were getting down, we were running, hitting Joel in the trailer.
quotes.quote: I think we were great. Obviously first half, like I say, we just had a lot of turnovers that kind of slowed us down, slow down our pace. I don't know if you could see like in the second half our pace picked up. We were getting down, we were running, hitting Joel in the trailer. So, like I say, we obviously we're going to try to find mismatches as much as possible, but at the end of the day, I say we got a lot of great players that can do it all on the floor and I think I think we'll be good.

quotes.quote: He's a leader. He's been in a situation like that before. He was just vocal the whole time. quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on Tyrese Maxey's defensive effort against James Harden
quotes.excerpt: I was impressed. I was impressed. I didn't know he guard like that.
quotes.quote: I was impressed. I was impressed. I didn't know he guard like that. He accepted the challenge and then he came down on the offensive and scored. Show a little bit of two-way. I don't know if he really a two-way though, but he played really great defense. Even when Harden came out, he came to me like, VJ, I got Mitchell. I'm like, all right, let's rock. Like, he acts he he wanted that challenge and he conquered that for sure.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe was impressed by Tyrese Maxey locking in on defense: I did not know he guard like that. He accepted the challenge and then he came down on the offensive end and scored. He wanted that challenge and he conquered that for sure.

quotes.speaker: VJ Edgecombe
quotes.summary_phrase: VJ Edgecombe on maintaining focus throughout the long season
quotes.excerpt: We don't want to fight back from down 29 every game.
quotes.quote: We don't want to fight back from down 29 every game. We know we got to be better. Like I say, it's just game two of 82 and we got 80 more games to go, but we know it's one game at a time. You know, we not looking forward to All-Star break or end of the season, March, you know, we so focused on next game, Milwaukee, that it don't matter on any given night, any team can come any team can come out hot.
quotes.social_post: VJ Edgecombe on the team mindset after a comeback win: We do not want to fight back from down 29 every game. We know we have to be better. It is just game two of 82 and we have 80 more games to go.

structured.context: VJ Edgecombe emphasizes the team's focus on the upcoming game against Milwaukee rather than the long-term schedule.
